found: Verifying in Expo Go, @rnmapbox/maps broke the Metro dev bundle: 'None of these files exist ...RNMBXCameraNativeComponent' — @rnmapbox imports Fabric native-spec components that only exist after a native codegen build, so Expo Go (and token-less dev) failed to compile.
root_cause: Runtime require-gating in MapCanvas does not stop Metro from statically bundling @rnmapbox.
fix: metro.config.js resolveRequest aliases @rnmapbox/maps -> src/components/map/mapbox-stub.js when EXPO_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN is absent (Expo Go/web/token-less). With a token (real dev/EAS build) the real module is used.

found: Running the sweep on the Android emulator (existing com.thirdplace.app dev build + Metro dev-client) crashed at map-route load: 'Cannot find native module ExpoLocation' — the dev build predates the expo-location/expo-haptics deps added this session (they eagerly require their native module at import).
fix: expo-location + expo-haptics now loaded lazily + guarded (try/catch require; Platform + null checks) so a build missing the native module degrades gracefully (location -> unavailable -> manual-area; haptics -> no-op) instead of crashing the route.
